summary: Comprehensive end-to-end testing for Kalvarayan Hills landing page (frontend + backend). All 8 backend pytest tests passed (root, contact CRUD, validation 422 cases, list endpoint with no _id leak). Full UI flow verified via Playwright: landing renders all 8 sections, header brand/scroll-style change, all nav links scroll to correct sections, mobile menu opens and navigates, hero CTAs (explore + contact) scroll, and contact form submits to POST /api/contact returning success toast. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger is referenced inside create_contact's except block but defined further below. It works at request time (lazy lookup) but is fragile — define logger before route definitions.
server.py: CORS allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origins=['*'] is technically invalid per CORS spec; works in dev but should specify explicit origins for production.

Hero.jsx: Title uses `
` and `` — assistive screen readers may read it disjointly; consider aria-label for full title.
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed contact records via POST /api/contact during pytest runs. Also one playwright_<ts>@example.com record. Cleanup not implemented (no DELETE endpoint exposed); records retained in 'contacts' collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has only /api/, /api/status (GET/POST), /api/contact (GET/POST). No auth. Use /app/backend/tests/test_kalvarayan_api.py as regression. Frontend single-page landing on /. All data-testid attributes verified working: site-header, site-name-link, hero-title, hero-section, hero-explore-btn, hero-contact-btn, nav-{about|attractions|gallery|activities|how-to-reach|contact}, mobile-menu-toggle, mobile-menu, mobile-nav-*, contact-form, contact-name, contact-email, contact-phone, contact-message, contact-submit-btn.
